name: synthadoc
tagline_zh: 把散乱文档炼成结构化本地维基，无需向量库和工具链。透明可读，自己就能改，告别黑盒RAG的失控感。
tagline_en: Turn messy docs into a local, structured wiki—no vector DB, no tools. Transparent and hand-editable, unlike.
desc_en: Synthadoc: An open-source LLM knowledge compilation engine that turns raw documents into structured, local-first wikis. A transparent, human-readable alternative to traditional RAG, which can be self-managed and self-improved without the use of any tools.
why_zh: 同类靠向量检索猜答案，它靠编译生成可读知识库，你能直接修改和迭代，真正自托管自进化。
why_en: Instead of guessing with vector search, it compiles docs into an editable wiki you can fix and grow—self-hosted, self-improved.
